name: Emberwhisk
description: A restless little fox whose coat trails soft embers wherever it trots.

name: Cinderpaw
description: A tiny salamander with glowing feet that leave warm trails on stone.

name: Glimmerfin
description: A darting pond sprite whose translucent fins shimmer like captured starlight.
traits: Hums a tune only dawn hears

name: Mossback
description: A gentle, slow wanderer whose shell is a living garden of moss and mushrooms.
traits: Sprouts tiny flowers as it naps

name: Stormling
description: A mischievous puff of stormcloud with bright arcs of static for a tail.
traits: Static makes its fur fluff up

name: Aurathorn
description: A serene forest guardian with antlers of pale crystal that catch the aurora.
traits: Antlers glow when it is content

name: Prismkit
description: A playful kitten whose body shatters light into drifting facets.
traits: Pelt shows every color at noon

name: Duskveil
description: A quiet moth-like creature wrapped in the first shade of evening.
